dialogue.english: Look at the bright moon! Let's read my story.
dialogue.twFullText: 看那輪明月！一起讀我的故事吧。

cards.english: Long ago, ten hot suns burned the sky.
Rivers dried up and everyone needed help.

dialogue.english: I must climb the mountain and save everyone!
dialogue.twFullText: 我一定要登上高山救百姓！

dialogue.english: It is way too hot! Who can help us?
dialogue.twFullText: 天太熱了！誰來救救我們？

cards.english: Hero Hou Yi draws his mighty golden bow.
cards.twFullText: 英雄后羿拉開射日神弓。

cards.english: He shoots nine suns, leaving one warm sun.
cards.twFullText: 他射下九日，留一輪暖陽。

dialogue.english: One gentle sun is enough to warm the earth!
dialogue.twFullText: 留一個太陽溫暖大地就好！

dialogue.english: Cool breezes and green rivers return at last!
dialogue.twFullText: 清風和綠水終於回來啦！

cards.english: The Queen Mother gifts a magic elixir.
Loving Chang'e, Hou Yi leaves it with her.
cards.twFullText: 后羿把仙藥交給嫦娥珍藏。

dialogue.english: I never want to leave you. Please keep it safe.
dialogue.twFullText: 我不願離開你，請收好玉匣。

dialogue.english: I will guard this jade box with all my heart.
dialogue.twFullText: 我會用心收好這只玉匣。

cards.english: One evening, greedy Peng Meng sneaks in.
cards.twFullText: 中秋黃昏，逢蒙闖入庭院。

cards.english: He tries to steal the magic jade box!

dialogue.english: Hand over the magic elixir right now!
No! I will never let a greedy man take it!
dialogue.twFullText: 不行！絕不能把仙藥給壞人！

cards.english: To keep it safe, brave Chang'e swallows it.
cards.twFullText: 情急之下，嫦娥吞下仙藥。

cards.english: Silver moonlight shines all around her.
cards.twFullText: 皎潔月光瞬間將她圍繞。

dialogue.english: Forgive me, Hou Yi! I had to protect it.
dialogue.twFullText: 對不起后羿，我只能這樣做。

dialogue.english: Bright moonbeams chase the greedy shadow away.
dialogue.twFullText: 明亮仙光趕走了貪婪壞人。

cards.english: Light as a feather, Chang'e floats skyward.
cards.twFullText: 嫦娥身輕如羽飄向夜空。

cards.english: She flies softly toward the glowing full moon.

dialogue.english: I will stay on the moon, closest to home.
dialogue.twFullText: 我就留在離家最近的月亮上。

dialogue.english: Golden osmanthus petals dance in the stars.
dialogue.twFullText: 金色桂花在星光中輕輕飄舞。

cards.english: Hou Yi gazes up at the shining moon.
cards.twFullText: 后羿仰望夜空明亮滿月。

cards.english: He sets out sweet mooncakes and fresh fruit.
cards.twFullText: 他在桂樹下擺滿月餅鮮果。

dialogue.english: Chang'e, I miss you every Mid-Autumn night!
dialogue.twFullText: 嫦娥，每個中秋我都想念你！

dialogue.english: Even far apart, we share the same bright moon.
dialogue.twFullText: 雖然遙遠，我們共賞同一輪明月。

cards.english: In the Moon Palace, Jade Rabbit keeps her company.
cards.twFullText: 月宮桂樹下，玉兔伴嫦娥。

cards.english: Families on Earth celebrate Mid-Autumn together!
cards.twFullText: 人間點亮花燈，中秋大團圓！

dialogue.english: Happy Mid-Autumn Festival to every family!
dialogue.twFullText: 祝家家戶戶中秋節快樂！

dialogue.english: May warm moonlight bless everyone tonight!
dialogue.twFullText: 願溫柔月光照亮每一份團圓！
